items.name: Mountain Pose
items.about: A standing pose with the feet grounded, the spine comfortably upright, and the arms resting alongside the body.
howToSteps: Begin from a stable standing position and settle your breathing.
Move gradually toward the shape without forcing your range of motion.
Keep the breath smooth and maintain a controlled, comfortable position.
Exit slowly and pause before changing position.
items.practiceSafety: Work within a comfortable range, avoid forcing the shape, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or loss of control.

items.about: Chin Stand is a arm balance asana traditionally known as Ganda Bherundasana. Practise the shape with steady breathing and controlled movement.
howToSteps: Build the prerequisite mobility, strength and balance through a qualified teacher’s progression.
Practise only the supported variation your teacher has assessed as appropriate for you.
Keep the breath steady and exit with assistance before control is lost.
